newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-SOUTH AFRICAN COACH MARKGRAAFF RESIGNS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-SOUTH AFRICAN COACH MARKGRAAFF RESIGNS.

text.p: South African rugby union manager Andre Markgraaff announced his resignation on Tuesday following allegations that he had made racial slurs.
"It's a tragic situation but I feel in the interests of the game it is the only way out," Markgraaff told a news conference in his home town of Kimberley after announcing his resignation.

The South African Rugby Football Union (SARFU) was to have held an investigation on Wednesday into the allegations that Markgraaff was the man making racist slurs in Afrikaans in a secretly taped conversation broadcast on national television on Monday.
South African rugby has been dogged by claims that, more than two years into the new democratic era, it has still not shaken off the country's racist apartheid past.
Markgraaff resigned after serving less than a year of a five-year contract as successor to Kitch Christie, who coached South Africa to victory in the 1995 World Cup.
